Inversions of the real picks. Each run goes in its own folder in `results/field/runs/`, set up the same way as a checkerboard run (see [How to add results](../../adding-results.qmd)). There is no true model here, so each slice is shown on its own, with the Slab2 slab top drawn on it for reference.

::: {data-akviewer="" data-src="runs.json" data-mode="run" data-truth="none"}
:::

## Slab comparison

Compare the slab recovered by the inversion with independent estimates of its geometry:

- **Slab2** depth contours for the Alaska–Aleutians region [@hayes2018; @hayes2018data]
- Published Alaska models [@berg2020; @martinshort2016; @nayak2020] and the other papers under *Validating inversion results* on the [Literature](../../literature/index.qmd) page

The depth slices and profiles of the first run already show the Slab2 slab top (green dashed line). A quantitative comparison is still to be added.
